title.id: AI, Reverse Engineering, dan Alasan Rust Makin Dilirik
title.en: AI, Reverse Engineering, and Why Rust Is Gaining Ground

summary.id: Bagaimana coding agent dan toolkit analisis biner REA mempercepat audit perangkat lunak, alasan model memori Rust dipilih untuk software native tanpa runtime GC, dan realitas membangun aplikasi desktop yang andal.
summary.en: How coding agents and binary analysis toolkits like REA accelerate software audits, why Rust's memory model is selected for native desktop tools without a GC, and the realities of building reliable software.

title.id: PHP2Shell: Mengupas 2 Kerentanan Kritis RCE PHP yang Ditemukan via AI
title.en: PHP2Shell: Dissecting 2 Critical PHP RCE Flaws Discovered via AI

summary.id: Beberapa hari terakhir, PHP2Shell ramai dibicarakan di dunia keamanan siber. Nama ini merujuk pada dua kerentanan kritis di PHP yang memungkinkan penyerang menjalankan kode dari jarak jauh (RCE) pada server yang belum diperbarui. Menariknya, celah ini ditemukan dengan bantuan AI (GPT-5.6 Sol) oleh Ryan Austin & Tim Wiz.
summary.en: Over the past few days, PHP2Shell has become a major talking point in cybersecurity. The name refers to two critical PHP vulnerabilities enabling remote code execution (RCE) on unpatched servers. Intriguingly, these flaws were discovered with AI assistance (GPT-5.6 Sol) by Ryan Austin and Wiz Research.

title.id: Memecahkan AES ECB → Blok demi Blok
title.en: Breaking AES ECB → Block by Block

author: Aditya Rahman

summary.id: Analisis cara kerja Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) pada mode Electronic Codebook (ECB). Membedah mekanisme padding PKCS#7, potongan blok 16 byte, implementasi Python pycryptodome, dan alasan fatal bocornya pola ciphertext.
summary.en: Analysis of the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) in Electronic Codebook (ECB) mode. Dissecting PKCS#7 padding, 16-byte block division, Python pycryptodome implementation, and why ciphertext pattern leaks occur.

code:
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
from Crypto.Random import get_random_bytes
from Crypto.Util.Padding import pad, unpad

# Kunci rahasia (16, 24, atau 32 byte untuk AES-128, AES-192, atau AES-256)
key = get_random_bytes(16)

# Buat objek cipher AES ECB
cipher = AES.new(key, AES.MODE_ECB)

# Plaintext Anda (harus kelipatan 16 byte dalam mode ECB)
plaintext = b'aditya rahman'

# padding ke kelipatan 16 byte
padded_plaintext = pad(plaintext, AES.block_size)

# Enkripsi plaintext
ciphertext = cipher.encrypt(padded_plaintext)

# Cetak ciphertext
print("Ciphertext:", ciphertext)
